title: Kodiak 100M — HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB 2026
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB
claims: The 100M is 161 KM with 4,876 m of gain, starts at Rim Nordic Ski Area on Friday 9 October 2026 at 13:00 and has a 36-hour limit; it carries 8 Running Stones.
The course circumnavigates the Big Bear Valley, includes a few miles on the Pacific Crest Trail and visits the Sugarloaf Mountain summit at 9,995 ft, with a lot of running above 7,000 ft.
The page says the 2026 routes are final and offers a final 2026 GPX file; its aid chart was updated on 10/6/2026 to note there is no parking at Doble Camp 1 or 2.
The page warns that minor data differences may exist between the aid-station chart and the profile, map and time-chart graphics.
